name: Punter Scoreboard
subject: Ricky Ponting
tagline: The unofficial Ricky Ponting fan site
description: An unofficial fan site for Ricky Ponting: career numbers by format, captaincy, records, innings replays and comparisons, with every figure sourced.
lede: The pull shot, the direct hit, the baggy green. A fan's scoreboard of Ricky Ponting's career, with every figure sourced and none guessed.
disclaimer: Unofficial fan site. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Ricky Ponting, Cricket Australia, the ICC, the BCCI, the IPL or any team. Statistics are compiled from public sources and credited where they appear.

captaincy.title: Captaincy
captaincy.lead: Australia's captain in Tests, one-day internationals and Twenty20s: the results, the batting with and without the armband, the World Cups and the Ashes.

records.title: Records
records.lead: Where he ranks all-time, the marks he holds, and the awards and halls of fame.

innings.title: Innings replay
innings.lead: Pick an innings and play it back ball by ball: the scoreboard, the run rate and the key moments, built from ball-by-ball data.

compare.title: Compare
compare.lead: Pick two batters and a format. Their career figures sit side by side, drawn as bars and as a radar, with a summary built from the same numbers.
compare.radarNote: Each axis is scaled so the higher of the two players reaches the outer edge. That is for drawing only: the shape compares the pair measure by measure, not one measure with another. The real values are in the bars beside it and in the tooltip.
eraNote: These are raw career figures. They are not adjusted for era, pitches, opposition, rules, equipment or how much cricket was scheduled in each career, and those differ between players.
Totals such as runs and hundreds grow with the length of a career. Averages and strike rates do not, but they carry their own context.
A player who is still active has figures that keep moving. Everything here is as of the retrieved date.
